purpose: Historical single-GPU measurements; no fleet capacity or pricing policy.

measurement_notes: Proposal timing includes input loading, production proving and verification, Succinct compression and an additional strict final verification; backend preparation and final output writes are excluded.

Proposal timing includes input loading, production proving and verification, Succinct compression and an additional strict final verification; backend preparation and final output writes are excluded.
An experimental public-SDK optimization port was used together with po22; it is not an official released configuration and is not shipped in this PR.
The experimental aggregation path was not remeasured; no combined result is inferred from the stock aggregation.
Warm same-process measurements: two proposal calls followed by two aggregations of the second genuine child; reported timings are the second call of each stage.
Timers include input cloning, CPU execution, setup, proving, production native verification and serialization; helper assertions and output writes are excluded.
The first aggregation included circuit asset installation and is excluded from this warm comparison.

The aggregation resource sample covers the entire process, including final Plonk wrapping and resident caches; it is not memory attributable to one child and cannot be multiplied to estimate one multi-child aggregation.
Proposal wall time is the full native CLI invocation with prepared assets, including key loading, program setup, proving, proof save and verification.
Aggregation sums separate native aggregation STARK, pilfflonk wrapping and final verification calls; fixture export is excluded.
Host working-set and GPU peaks are sampled; aggregation resources use the maximum across aggregation and final wrapping.

limits: One complete saved proposal and single-child aggregation; no representative workload distribution, multi-child aggregation, concurrent throughput or multi-GPU speedup was measured.
Serial sums are arithmetic sums of the measured stages, not service end-to-end latency.
Sampled working-set and GPU maxima are not exact instantaneous peaks, total-host RAM or per-child memory requirements.
SDK process/cache conditions and native proof formats differ; this is not a comparison of equivalent circuits.
The Docker recipe runs operator-provided runtime images; these records do not claim that current main or the recipe reproduces every historical driver.
